morphos_iso_source.read_method: HTTP byte-range reads of the ISO directory and the single AddDataTypes file extent

binary.evidence_limit: The packed MorphOS executable wraps an ELF payload whose code section is encrypted; no loader-stack constant was recovered from static disassembly.

released_source.evidence: The source initializes DefaultStack from AROS_STACKSIZE for embedded DTCD loading and separately initializes it to 4096 in the file-function-name path.

target_header.evidence_limit: This is the pinned official ppc-morphos target header value available in the current AROS tree. Its correspondence to the exact November 2004 header used to build AddDataTypes 50.6 is not yet established.

candidate.verification: Supplied-vector resident fixtures now assert this value for MorphOS CLI and Workbench startup paths.

binary.evidence: Static 68000 disassembly shows MOVE.L #$1000 into the stack-size cell before each InternalLoadSeg call; the DTCD path passes that cell at code offset 0x0d62.

candidate.verification: Supplied-vector resident fixtures assert this value for the Workbench 3.1 CLI profile.

remaining_gates: Bind the exact historical ppc-morphos/AROS header or an authentic guest execution to the 2004 MorphOS command binary.
Exercise the real MorphOS DOS InternalLoadSeg callback and segment-unload behavior in a guest.
